childSafety.title: Suspected child sexual abuse material
childSafety.legalReview: This procedure must be validated by a lawyer before launch. Obligations depend on the country of hosting and of the people running the site.
childSafety.explain: This action is immediate and irreversible from the app: it blocks all public access, deletes every preview, locks the original (preserved for the authorities, inaccessible to staff), suspends the account and closes the reports. The file will never be sent to an AI service.
childSafety.step1: Do not download, copy or share the content, not even to show a colleague.
childSafety.step2: Report it without delay to the competent authorities: in Mauritania, the judicial police (juvenile unit) or the public prosecutor; if the host or the team is abroad, that country’s national body (for example PHAROS in France, NCMEC in the United States, or a hotline in the INHOPE network).
childSafety.step3: Give them the photo reference and the SHA-256 fingerprint recorded in the log; hand over the file only on the authorities’ written request, following their instructions.
childSafety.step4: Keep the record: the file is under legal hold and will not be deleted automatically. Note the date and the number of your report.
childSafety.step5: Do not tell the account holder what the report is about.
